# Exact ordinary Pikachu fixture

`pikachu-normal.png` is the unchanged published PokeAPI HOME normal Pikachu front PNG:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PokeAPI/sprites/master/sprites/pokemon/other/home/25.png

SHA256: `6a9305fbd6f02345153567f4142faf019380b1a1c839cfa3f2349cc36d536a40`.
512x512,79,086bytes. It was visually inspected as ordinary male normal-colour Pikachu. This is a test-only interception fixture, excluded from the frontend artifact; it replaces the former executor-only `/tmp/max-originals/pikachu.png` dependency. No generated pixels or species/costume substitutions.
